summary: Recruitment rules modification mid-process; eligibility criteria changed after notification; 75% cutoff imposed contrary to existing rules; retrospective application of selection standards; constitutional validity under Articles 14 and 309; State employer cannot alter rules post-notification; reference to larger bench for authoritative pronouncement; Manjusree case reconsidered; Marwaha precedent distinguished; final decision pending reference.
final_judgment: Reference directed to larger bench; matter listed before Chief Justice for constitution of larger bench; interim status quo maintained.
